entities.name: Methyl ester hydrolysis
observations: The supplied transformation converts a methyl ester, –C(=O)OCH3, into the corresponding carboxylic acid, –C(=O)OH.
The amide, difluorophenyl group, N–C connectivity, and stereocenter are retained; no ring rearrangement is indicated.

entities.name: LiOH methanol water
observations: Matching ORD records use lithium hydroxide in methanol/water for methyl-ester hydrolysis.
Reported reaction time is approximately 4 hours, with yields of 98.1–99.1%.
Acidification during workup is chemically expected to convert the lithium carboxylate to the free carboxylic acid, although it was not explicitly listed in the retrieved records.
